sentences.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
sentences.zh: 他们的主要出口是纺织品，尤其是丝绸和棉布。

sentences.en: He's an Algerian entrepreneur who made his fortune in the textile industry.
sentences.zh: 他是一位阿尔及利亚企业家，在纺织行业赚得了财富。

sentences.en: Textile News has a large following among those working in the textile industry.
sentences.zh: 《纺织新闻》在从事纺织行业的人员中拥有大量的读者群。
